name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No blockade or clash; Shenzhen talks 19 Nov
summary: No blockade, clash or new sanctions found by 17 Nov; Trump and Xi due to meet at APEC in Shenzhen on 19 Nov
state: Ahead of the 19 Nov Shenzhen meeting, the US, China and Russia were reported to be negotiating an AI and nuclear agenda, with Beijing resisting arms-control talks (SCMP, 13 Nov). Taiwan reported sustained PLA activity in early November, including 30 aircraft in the day to 13 Nov. No blockade, military clash or severed channel was found as of 17 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Shipping, electronics and chip supply chains through the Taiwan Strait are the most exposed to any escalation. Travellers to Taiwan or China should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Sustained large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan = Watch; no blockade, clash or severed channels

sources.title: Navigating China-US power play at Shenzhen Apec

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
